def count_rotation(arr):
    """Return how many rotations turn a sorted array into arr.

    That count is len(arr) minus the index of the smallest value.
    A minimum already at the front means the array is unrotated.
    """
    if not arr:
        return 0
    min_index = arr.index(min(arr))
    if min_index == 0:
        return 0
    return len(arr) - min_index
